initializing.heading: Getting Fluyo ready
initializing.body: Checking your session and app setup.

signed_out.heading: Sign in to continue
signed_out.body: Use your Fluyo account to continue in this internal build.

authenticated.heading: You’re signed in
authenticated.body: Your account is ready on this device.

offline_session_candidate.heading: You’re offline
offline_session_candidate.body: Reconnect to verify your account and continue.

expired_or_revoked.heading: Your session ended
expired_or_revoked.body: Sign in again to continue safely.

account_switching.heading: Switching accounts
account_switching.body: Clearing the previous account before opening the next one.

unusable_link.heading: This sign-in link can’t be used
unusable_link.body: It may be incomplete, expired, or already used. Start sign-in again.

transportOrServer.heading: We couldn’t finish that
transportOrServer.body: Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.

forbidden.heading: You can’t open this
forbidden.body: Return to a safe screen to continue.
